subject: Finova - Decision criteria follow-up (latency / SLA / deployment)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachael Singh <rachael.singh@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Finova discovery recap — decision criteria & next steps

Hi Rachael / Finova team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good conversation and appreciated the clarity on your use case (customer support automation + Knowledge base augmentation). Quick recap and a few follow-ups to make sure we have the right internal stakeholders and criteria captured: 

- Stakeholders you mentioned: Ajay Mehta (CFO / economic buyer), Linda Gomez (Procurement lead), Priya Reddy (Legal), Ben (Security contact — please confirm full name).
- Decision criteria we captured on the call:
  - Latency: target P95 for full responses in your typical 128-token scenario (interactive chat) — you mentioned wanting <500ms, ideally <350ms in us-west.
  - Deployment mode: preference for Private (VPC) for data residency, but open to Dedicated reserved capacity if Private increases delivery time.
  - SLA: enterprise SLA expected (99.9% uptime, audit logs, incident notifications).
  - Cost: economics matter — you flagged wanting at least a ~50% cost improvement vs your current vendor or a clear ROI case.
  - Security/compliance: SOC 2 report, penetration test summary, and answers to a short questionnaire.

Action items from Redwood:
- I’ll send our proposed pricing + MAP and a short performance note on P95 latency targets for Dedicated vs Private in us-west.
- Marcus will add a short benchmark spec to validate the latency numbers against your average sequence lengths.
- Naomi will send our SOC 2 attestation and a pen-test summary; we’ll also attach a completed security questionnaire for your review.

Can you confirm: (1) final list of internal approvers (Ajay, Linda, Priya — correct?), (2) procurement timeline (weeks to contract), and (3) which environment you’d prefer for a short benchmark (Private VPC vs Dedicated)?

Attached: redwood-proposed-pricing-20280601.pdf, redwood-mutual-action-plan-20280601.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up with Ajay + procurement next week if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Rachael Singh <rachael.singh@finova.com>

Cc: Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@finova.com>, Ajay Mehta <ajay.mehta@finova.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finova.com>, procurement@finova.com
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova discovery recap — decision criteria & next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Correct on the stakeholders: Ajay (CFO) is the economic buyer and will own final approval on spend; Linda is our procurement lead and will own contracting; Priya (legal) will do the security & terms review.

Clarifications from our side:
- Latency: We are aiming for P95 < 500ms for an average 128-token response in us-west. If Redwood can commit to ~350ms P95 on Dedicated, that would be ideal; for Private VPC we need to understand the delta (we don’t want to sacrifice SLA).
- SLA: Target is enterprise SLA — 99.9% uptime, incident notifications within 15 minutes for Sev 1, and access to audit logs / request traces for compliance.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is required; we also ask for a recent penetration test summary. I’m attaching our security questionnaire — if you can populate and return that, we’ll run it through our InfoSec.
- Procurement timeline: target 6-8 weeks from final commercial terms to fully executed contract (assuming no major redlines).

I’ve attached the questionnaire here: finova-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx. Please return it with any supporting docs.

We’re open to a short benchmark run — would prefer Dedicated for the initial proof if the latency numbers line up, but we need to see the Private VPC performance as a variation.

Next step: Linda will coordinate a meeting with Ajay next week to review commercials.

Thanks,
Rachael
CTO, Finova
rachael.singh@finova.com

Attached: finova-security-questionnaire-template.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachael Singh <rachael.singh@finova.com>, Linda Gomez <linda.gomez@finova.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova discovery recap — decision criteria & next steps

Hi Rachael / Linda — appreciate the details and the questionnaire. See responses and attachments below: 

- SOC 2 / security: Attached is our SOC 2 Type II attestation (redwood-soc2-2028.pdf) and a pen-test summary. We’ve completed the questionnaire and attached it as finova-security-questionnaire-answered.xlsx. Naomi has also included notes on telemetry/audit log retention.
- Latency / deployment: Based on the profile you shared, our engineering benchmarks indicate: 
  - Dedicated (reserved capacity, us-west): expected P95 ~ 300-380ms for 128-token end-to-end response (including model + prefix caching) depending on model choice and quantization.
  - Private VPC (customer-managed network): typically adds network overhead; P95 commonly increases by ~50-120ms depending on customer egress and VPC peering. We can run a 24-48 hour benchmark in your VPC to measure exact numbers.
- SLA: We can offer a 99.9% uptime SLA on Dedicated with 15-minute incident notifications for Sev1 and access to request-level traces for the compliance window. For Private deployments we can support similar SLA commitments as part of an enterprise package — will need to surface the control-plane connectivity requirements in the contract.
- Pricing & economics: Attached is the revised pricing sheet (redwood-proposed-pricing-20280601.pdf) with a Dedicated committed tier that should meet the ~50% cost-improvement target versus typical off-the-shelf hosted options.

Action items we’ve completed and next steps: 
- Attached: finova-security-questionnaire-answered.xlsx, redwood-mutual-action-plan-20280601.docx
- Proposed next step: 30-min meeting with Ajay + Linda + Rachael to review pricing and MAP this week. Linda — can you please propose 2-3 time slots?
- We’ll provision a short Dedicated benchmark and a Private VPC checklist for the eng perf run once you confirm the environment and timeline.

Thanks — happy to jump on the call and walk Ajay through the cost model.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
